subject: CloudMall partner program renewal — proposed incentive and listing options
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudmall.io>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: partner-ops@cloudmall.io
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:23:00 -0400
Subject: CloudMall partner program renewal & listing fee updates

Hi Dylan,

Hope you're well — thanks again for the participation in the co-sell summit last month. We're kicking off our partner program renewals and wanted to share a heads-up on two items that will affect Redwood's listing and incentives for the upcoming 12-month term:

1) Listing fee re-banding: to simplify tiers we're moving to a blended listing fee (from 12% to a 14% blended rate) for partners who do not meet the new joint-revenue threshold.
2) Co-sell credit cadence: credits will now be processed quarterly and require a signed SOW with minimum traction commitments.

I've attached a short note outlining the proposed changes and a draft timeline. Can we get a quick call next week to go over options? Our prioritization window closes July 10.

Attachments: [CloudMall_Renewal_Request_Jun15.pdf]

Thanks,
Liam
Partnerships Lead, CloudMall
liam.oconnor@cloudmall.io

Onward to a good renewal — Liam

Subject: FW: CloudMall partner program renewal & listing fee updates

Flagging — CloudMall pushed a change to listing fees and credit cadence. They want a decision window by July 10. Fast ask: can we agree on negotiation positions and counter options we can present on the 6/24 call?

Summary of ask from partner (attachment from Liam):
- Move to blended listing fee starting next term (12% -> 14% unless they hit joint-revenue threshold)
- Quarterly processing of co-sell credits, requires signed SOW + min traction

Suggested negotiation levers (first pass):
- Option A (Conservative): Hold listing fee at current 12% for one-year if Redwood commits to a minimum 12-month marketplace marketing spend of $60k and 6 co-sell lead handoffs per quarter. Quarterly credit processing accepted.
- Option B (Growth): Accept 14% blended listing fee but secure a guaranteed 6% co-marketing rebate (applied as marketplace credit) and expedited monthly credit reconciliation for the first 2 quarters; require a pilot SOW for 90 days.
- Option C (Strategic): Multi-year commitment (18 months) with tiered listing fee rollback to 10% if annual joint-revenue > $1.2M + dedicated CloudMall listings spot in their marketplace landing page (paid placement).

Risks & internal asks:
- Finance needs to model P&L impact vs expected ARR; can you run a 12-month unit economics scenario for options A/B/C and note cashflow hit from upfront co-marketing? (Karthik)
- Legal will need to review SOW template changes (I can loop in legal once we land on terms).
- Growth wants concrete KPIs for leads -> pipeline conversion before agreeing to placement requests.

Attachments I will propose to send to partner: Redwood_CoSell_Proposal_v1.xlsx (pricing scenarios), CloudMall_SOW_Draft_v2.docx (pilot SOW).

Can we sync 6/19 10am PT to finalize the two options we bring to the partner?

Thanks,
Dylan

[Quoted original from Liam O'Connor included below]
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: CloudMall partner program renewal & listing fee updates

Thanks for the summary — good framing. I ran quick finance back-of-envelope and here's what I recommend we test with them:

Counter-proposal (two-track ask to present):
1) Standard commercial track (short-term): Redwood holds current 12% listing fee for 12 months in exchange for:
   - $60k committed marketing fund (payable quarterly),
   - Minimum 24 qualified marketplace leads / quarter or revenue-equivalent (we track via marketplace impressions + lead tracking),
   - Quarterly credit processing (standard cadence).

2) Aggressive incentive track (growth): Redwood accepts blended 14% listing fee but requests:
   - 6% co-marketing rebate applied as monthly marketplace credit (reduces net take),
   - Monthly reconciliation for first 90 days, then quarterly thereafter,
   - Two-week marketplace feature placement during product launches (value = marketing credit).

Don't offer placement or rate rollback unless they lock an 18-mo commitment with clearly defined revenue milestones. If they push for immediate placement, insist on proof of pipeline (HubSpot IDs) and a signed SOW.

Karthik: can you confirm the cashflow profile for the $60k fund vs expected uplift? If we need to tile this across quarters, propose 50/30/20 arrangement.

I'll draft the email to Liam once we finalize exact wording + attach the SOW + pricing sheet.

Marissa Cole
VP, GTM Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudmall.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudMall partner program renewal & listing fee updates

Liam — thanks for your patience while we modeled options. Per our call notes and internal alignment, here are two concrete paths Redwood can accept for the 12-month renewal. Please review and let us know which you prefer by July 10 so we can lock the timelines and legal review.

Option 1 — Stabilize (short-term protective):
- Maintain current listing fee at 12% for 12 months
- Redwood commits $60k marketing fund spread over 4 quarters (50/30/20 split)
- Quarterly credit processing per your stated cadence
- KPI clause: CloudMall to provide marketplace lead export (HubSpot IDs) monthly; 24 qualified marketplace leads / quarter target

Option 2 — Growth (faster scale):
- Accept blended 14% listing fee for the term
- CloudMall provides a 6% co-marketing rebate applied as monthly marketplace credit (reduces our net fee)
- Monthly reconciliation for first 90 days, then quarterly thereafter
- One two-week featured placement around Redwood product launches (dates to be mutually agreed)
- Pilot SOW (attached) to govern the first 90 days with defined KPIs and acceptance criteria

Next steps we suggest:
- Please confirm preferred option by 2027-07-10.
- If Option 1 selected, we'll send a concise amendment to the existing listing agreement for signature (legal review in parallel).
- If Option 2 selected, sign the attached Pilot SOW and we'll begin monthly reconciliations.

Attachments: [Redwood_CoSell_Proposal_v1.xlsx], [CloudMall_SOW_Draft_v2.docx]

Thanks — happy to jump on a follow-up call if you want to walk through the numbers.

Best regards,
Dylan Brooks
Head of GTM Partnerships, Redwood Inference
